ozempic_cigna.criteria_text:
PA Requirements — Ozempic (semaglutide) / Cigna Connect 500 PPO (cnf_360)
Source: Cigna GLP-1 Agonists PA Policy (cnf_360); last revised 05/06/2026.

Criteria (all must be met):
1. Confirmed diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) — ICD-10 E11.x.
2. Patient age >= 18 years at time of request (Ozempic injection and tablets).
3. Indication limited to glycemic management in T2DM. Weight-loss use is excluded; Ozempic prescribed for obesity/weight management (not T2DM) is out of scope. Payer may request prescriber attestation when chart documents BMI or weight-management goals alongside T2DM.
4. No concomitant GLP-1 or GLP-1/GIP agonist on the active medication list (including weight-management agents Wegovy, Saxenda, Zepbound).

Note: No HbA1c threshold is stated in this policy. No prior metformin or oral antidiabetic step therapy is required. Approval period: 1 year.

Conditions not covered: Type 1 DM; prediabetes without T2DM diagnosis; metabolic syndrome without T2DM; concomitant GLP-1/GIP agonist use.

esomeprazole_uhc_pediatric.criteria_text:
PA Requirements — Nexium suspension (esomeprazole) / UnitedHealthcare (Step Therapy Program 2025 P 3035-15)
Source: UHC Step Therapy Proton Pump Inhibitors, effective 08/01/2025.

Criteria — coverage on ONE of the following pathways:
A. PPI Step therapy failure: Documented failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL THREE of:
   1. A prescription formulation of omeprazole
   2. Pantoprazole
   3. Rabeprazole
   Reason must be provided for each agent.

B. Swallowing limitation: Patient is unable to swallow a tablet or capsule due to age, oral/motor difficulties, or dysphagia.

C. Feeding tube: Medications administered via feeding tube.

Pediatric auto-process rule: Patients under age 6 — no PA required. Step therapy applies for ages 6 and older.

Approval period: 12 months.

livdelzi_cigna_hepatology.criteria_text:
PA Requirements — Livdelzi (seladelpar) / Cigna (cnf_877)
Source: Cigna Hepatology – Livdelzi PA Policy (cnf_877); effective 08/13/2025.

Criteria (all must be met):
1. Confirmed PBC diagnosis in adult (age >= 18): at least 2 of 3 AASLD criteria:
   a. ALP elevated above ULN per lab reference values
   b. Positive AMA, or PBC-specific auto-antibodies (sp100 or gp210) if AMA-negative
   c. Histologic evidence from liver biopsy (not required if both a and b are met)
2. Specialist prescriber: gastroenterologist, hepatologist, or liver transplant physician.
3. UDCA step therapy — ONE of:
   a. Ursodiol therapy for >= 12 months with inadequate response (prescriber attestation)
   b. Patient unable to tolerate ursodiol (prescriber attestation)
4. No current or prior hepatic decompensation (ascites, variceal bleeding, hepatic encephalopathy, coagulopathy) — absolute contraindication for both initial and renewal.

Conditions not covered: alcoholic liver disease; MASLD/NAFLD/MASH/NASH; concomitant Ocaliva (obeticholic acid) or Iqirvo (elafibranor) use.
Authorization periods: 6 months initial, 12 months continuation (continuation requires demonstrated response + no decompensation).

humira_cigna.criteria_text:
PA Requirements — Humira (adalimumab) / Cigna Connect 3000 PPO (IP0652, Rheumatoid Arthritis)
Source: Cigna Drug Coverage Policy IP0652 — Inflammatory Conditions – Adalimumab Products Prior Authorization Policy; effective 05/01/2026.

Initial therapy (6 months) — ALL of the following (§7.A):
1. Patient is >= 18 years of age (§7.A.i).
2. Patient has tried ONE conventional synthetic DMARD (e.g. methotrexate, leflunomide, hydroxychloroquine, sulfasalazine) for at least 3 months (§7.A.ii). Waived if the patient already had a >= 3-month trial of a biologic other than the requested medication; a biosimilar of the requested biologic does not count.
3. Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist (§7.A.iii).

Step therapy — preferred-product requirement (p. 5 NOTE): brand Humira is a NON-PREFERRED adalimumab product (NDCs starting 83457 listed as not covered); trial/use of the plan's preferred adalimumab products is required before approval of a non-preferred product. Exception criteria are adjudicated under the cross-referenced Preferred Specialty Management policy (PSM003/PSM013/PSM014).

Safety: concurrent use with another biologic or a targeted synthetic oral small molecule drug is not covered; conventional synthetic DMARDs in combination ARE permitted (Conditions Not Covered §1 + Note).

Renewal (1 year, §7.B): patient established on therapy >= 6 months AND beneficial clinical response (objective measure, e.g. CDAI or DAS-28, or symptom improvement).
